name: Dagashiya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood old-fashioned candy shop (Komadori Dagashi-ten): a notice about opening hours changing, a first day working part-time at the shop, a usage-and-price guide, a first day trusted alone at the register, a comparison of two lottery-candy restocking rules for new staff, a column about a regular child's first time shopping alone with their own money, teaching a junior staff member how the winning-ticket lottery works, an essay on why old-fashioned candy shops are being reappraised, a temporary closure notice for store renovation, a column on changing how you serve different children, a notice of revised handling rules for allergy and safety reasons, an essay on what small purchases mean to children, and a one-year cooperation report with a local children's cafeteria about donating leftover seasonal snacks. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
